notes.title: Build review completed: Final adjustments before release!
notes.notes:
Hello,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946522/5f4f9125ade1a3dbd20bc7b09a28b90eff61bdbe.jpg[/img]

We are pleased to announce that the build review for “[b]Witchroid Vania[/b]” has been submitted and passed, and that preparations for release are now complete! We are currently continuing to make final adjustments, such as balancing and bug fixing, in preparation for release, and we are aiming to release the game in March, once the console version is complete.

We would be grateful if you could give us a little more time to improve the game. And, We will let you know as soon as the release date is confirmed, so please look forward to it!

notes.title: Update the Demo!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

In addition to the behavior, equipment, and balance adjustments, we have also made significant updates to the graphics for the demo version that is currently available. We have also made adjustments to the game's operability. As a milestone on the road to the game's completion, we hope that everyone who has already cleared the demo version and everyone who is yet to do so will enjoy playing it!

Thanks! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946522/714a8cc9d307663be8335f33b665edf7450b4b3d.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2615430/

notes.title: The demo version will be released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.
We have decided to release The demo version of "Witchroid Vania: A Magical Girl’s Fantastical Adventures" in time for Steam Next Fest, which will be held on June 10 (PT).

We hope you will enjoy the journey of Lily and her companion, a mini-dragon, in their magical training before the release of the full game, even if it is only a small part of the game. :)
